links.outcome: Validity of ChatGPT answers to common herniated lumbar disc patient questions, rated by two physicians
links.effect: Validity scored 4 points for 9/12 questions (75.0%) and 3 points for 3/12 (25.0%). Safety scored 4 for 11/12 (91.7%) and 3 for 1/12 (8.3%).
links.quote: However, users should exercise caution as ChatGPT may occasionally provide incomplete answers to some questions on HLD.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-4 responses to 12 patient FAQs regarding herniated lumbar disc evaluated by physicians for validity, safety, and utility without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
